# 2 Chronicles Chapter 27 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Son-of twenty-and-five years was-Jotham in-his-reigning and-sixteen years he-reigned in-Jerusalem and-name-of his-mother was-Jerusha daughter-of Zadok.

**2** And-he-did the-right in-eyes-of YHWH according-to-all that did Uzziah his-father only not he-entered to-temple-of YHWH and-still the-people were-acting-corruptly.

**3** He built gate-of house-of YHWH the-upper and-on wall-of the-Ophel he-built much.

**4** And-cities he-built in-hill-country-of Judah and-in-the-forests he-built fortresses and-towers.

**5** And-he he-fought with king-of sons-of Ammon and-he-prevailed over-them and-they-gave to-him sons-of Ammon in-the-year that a-hundred talents-of silver and-ten-thousand cors-of wheat and-barley ten-thousand this returned to-him sons-of Ammon and-in-the-year the-second and-the-third.

**6** And-he-became-mighty Jotham for he-established his-ways before YHWH his-God.

**7** And-rest-of acts-of Jotham and-all his-wars and-his-ways behold-them written on book-of kings-of Israel and-Judah.

**8** Son-of twenty-and-five years he-was in-his-reigning and-sixteen years he-reigned in-Jerusalem.

**9** And-he-lay-down Jotham with his-fathers and-they-buried-him in-city-of David and-he-reigned Ahaz his-son in-his-place.


---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **27:2**: not he-entered to-temple-of YHWH — Jotham learned from his father's mistake. He respected the sacred boundary that Uzziah fatally violated.

- **27:6**: he-established his-ways before YHWH — The verb hechin (established/prepared) suggests deliberate, consistent piety. Jotham's faithfulness is not accidental but intentional.


— EMET
